Subject: Contract terms — Finlytics pilot

Marissa / Dev —

Thanks again for the demo last week. The pilot team is excited and we are ready to move to a 3‑month pilot if we can align on a few commercial points. Attaching the SOW and a proposed pricing schedule.

High level asks from our side:
- MFN: We need an MFN clause that guarantees Finlytics the most favorable pricing during the pilot and for 6 months after launch.
- Benchmark: We require a measurable benchmark (95th percentile latency < 200ms) and a payment credit if Redwood misses it for two consecutive weeks.
- Exclusivity: A 90‑day exclusivity in our market segment for the pilot geography.

We understand these are non‑standard — happy to discuss tradeoffs (credits, measurement methods). Please review and tell us what you can do.

Attachments: Finlytics_SOW_draft.pdf, pricing_grid_v2.xlsx

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 14:20:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Contract terms — Finlytics pilot (internal analysis)

Team — quick internal breakdown after reviewing the SOW and pricing grid:

1) MFN
- Risk: Broad MFN tied to any "more favorable terms" across product lines could force us to retroactively lower pricing for other customers or reveal sensitive concessions.
- Recommendation: If allowed, narrow MFN to identical product configuration, same contract length and volume tiers; apply only to list/standard pricing, exclude marketplace / channel offers. Limit look‑back to 90 days.

2) Benchmark / performance credit
- Risk: The benchmark as written (95p <200ms, two consecutive weeks) is fragile — measurement method isn't defined and could be triggered by noisy production events or misuse.
- Recommendation: Replace with a mutually‑agreed performance test harness and a monthly SLA credit cap (max 5% of monthly fees).

3) Exclusivity
- Risk: 90 days exclusivity for a pilot is excessive and restricts GTM motion.
- Recommendation: If needed, accept a 14–30 day exclusivity limited to the exact customer use‑case, not entire market.

4) Commercial concession
- To move quickly we can offer a one‑time pilot discount (10%) and a capped credit pool in exchange for tightening MFN and removing broad exclusivity.

Attached: redlined_SOW.pdf (proposed language), risk_matrix_finlytics.xlsx

If this approach is acceptable, Markus can draft the formal counter and we'll escalate for exec sign‑off on any final concession beyond 10%.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Deal Desk — Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Escalation: Finlytics — MFN / benchmark / exclusivity (legal review)

Team —

Legal review and ask for executive approval: the Finlytics draft contains three high‑risk commercial clauses that require approval before we send a counter. Summary below:

- MFN: The clause is phrased as a broad "most favorable terms" obligation with no carveouts. This could result in obligations across channel deals and partner integrations. Legal position is that we will not accept a blanket MFN.

- Benchmark & credits: The metric is unscoped. We need a measurable test harness and a maximum credit pool. Open credit with no cap exposes us to unpredictable financial liability.

- Exclusivity: 90 days is excessive for a pilot and could lock us out of competing trials and partner integrations. Not acceptable as drafted.

Proposed concessions for exec approval:
1) Approve a one‑time pilot discount: 10% off pilot fees (financial approved by RevOps).
2) Allow a limited MFN narrowly defined as "published list price for identical product configuration and volume tier," excluding channel/marketplace offers and limited to 90 day look‑back.
3) Replace the benchmark clause with a performance target measured by a jointly‑defined test script, with a monthly SLA credit capped at 5% of monthly fees and a total exposure cap of one month's fees.
4) Exclusivity capped at 14 days post‑pilot signoff and only for the specific use‑case described in the SOW.

Requesting Evelyn's sign‑off to proceed with this counter. If approved, I'll prepare the redline and Marissa can send the commercial counteroffer to Finlytics.

--
Markus Klein
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Escalation: Finlytics — MFN / benchmark / exclusivity (legal review)

Markus / team —

Thanks for the concise analysis. I approve the proposed approach with the following clarifications:

- MFN: We will accept a narrowly scoped MFN limited to identical product configuration, term and volume; it must explicitly exclude marketplace/channel pricing and promotional offers. The MFN should be tied to published list price and subject to a 90‑day look‑back.

- Benchmark / credit: Replace with a jointly‑defined performance test harness. Approve an SLA credit structure capped at 5% monthly with a total exposure cap equal to one month's fees for the pilot. No open‑ended credits.

- Exclusivity: No more than 14 days after formal pilot acceptance; limit to the single use‑case in the SOW. Do not accept broad market exclusivity.

- Commercial tradeoff: I authorize the 10% one‑time pilot discount. Any additional concessions require my sign‑off.

Next steps: Markus, please finalize the redline and include the approved caps/wording. Jordan, update the HubSpot deal FIN‑2026‑042 and mark the internal approval stage as "Exec Approved — Limited High‑Risk Clauses". Marissa, send the counter to Claire referencing the attached redline and the one‑time pilot credit.

Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
VP, Revenue — Redwood Inference
